description: A small ReAgent engineering topic set for human review of OpenAlex discovery; it is not a universal scholarly-search benchmark.

topics.title: Persistent research agents
topics.research_question: Which systems support memory, recovery, and long-running execution for research-oriented agents?
topics.language_policy: English metadata preferred; record missing language without exclusion.
topics.document_type_policy: Research articles and conference papers; preprints remain distinct.
topics.rationale: Exercises the accepted live topic and ambiguous use of agent, persistence, and research terminology.
expected_ambiguity_cases: software agents versus human research agents

topics.title: Machine unlearning verification
topics.research_question: How is removal of training-data influence verified after machine unlearning?
topics.language_policy: No hard language filter; record language metadata.
topics.document_type_policy: Conference, journal, and preprint manifestations stay separate.
topics.rationale: Tests a narrow technical phrase and duplicate preprint/published manifestations.

topics.title: Gut microbiome and immunotherapy response
topics.research_question: What associations are reported between the gut microbiome and response to cancer immunotherapy?
topics.language_policy: English abstracts preferred for review; do not infer language when absent.
topics.document_type_policy: Human studies and reviews are eligible; animal-only studies require an exclusion reason.
topics.rationale: Tests biomedical terminology, study-type ambiguity, and high-volume discovery.

topics.title: Long COVID cognitive symptoms
topics.topic: long COVID cognitive impairment longitudinal study
topics.research_question: What longitudinal evidence characterizes cognitive symptoms after COVID-19?
topics.language_policy: No hard language exclusion; reviewer needs an English abstract or marks CANNOT_JUDGE.
topics.document_type_policy: Longitudinal observational studies prioritized; reviews retained for relevance judgment.
topics.rationale: Exercises evolving terminology and abstract-only study-design interpretation.

topics.title: Algorithmic management and worker autonomy
topics.research_question: How does algorithmic management affect worker autonomy and control?
topics.language_policy: Multilingual metadata allowed; record review-language limitations.
topics.document_type_policy: Empirical social-science and labor studies; commentary is advisory.
topics.rationale: Tests overlap across management, sociology, information systems, and labor research.
expected_ambiguity_cases: workforce scheduling algorithms versus general automation

topics.title: Decolonizing digital archives
topics.research_question: How is community participation framed in work on decolonizing digital archives?
topics.language_policy: No hard language filter; multilingual and regional work is desirable.
topics.document_type_policy: Journal articles, chapters, and conference work are eligible.
topics.rationale: Tests humanities coverage, book-chapter metadata, and missing abstracts.

topics.title: Lithium-ion battery thermal runaway propagation
topics.topic: lithium ion battery thermal runaway propagation mitigation
topics.research_question: Which engineering approaches mitigate cell-to-cell thermal runaway propagation?
topics.language_policy: No hard language filter; preserve non-English records.
topics.document_type_policy: Experimental and modeling studies; patents excluded from relevance gold.
topics.rationale: Tests specialized engineering vocabulary and venue completeness.
expected_ambiguity_cases: cell thermal runaway versus pack propagation

topics.title: Urban heat mitigation and equity
topics.topic: urban heat mitigation environmental justice equity
topics.research_question: How do urban heat mitigation interventions account for distributional equity?
topics.language_policy: Multilingual and Global South records retained; missing language is advisory.
topics.document_type_policy: Empirical environmental, planning, and public-health studies.
topics.rationale: Tests interdisciplinary discovery and geographic representation.
expected_ambiguity_cases: physical cooling performance without equity analysis
heat vulnerability mapping versus intervention evaluation

topics.title: Interdisciplinary team science collaboration
topics.research_question: Which factors are associated with effective interdisciplinary research-team collaboration?
topics.language_policy: English metadata preferred; no hard provider language filter.
topics.document_type_policy: Empirical studies and validated frameworks; editorials retained for screening.
topics.rationale: Tests collision between scientific team research and generic teamwork literature.
expected_ambiguity_cases: clinical care teams versus research teams

topics.title: Smallholder climate adaptation in sub-Saharan Africa
topics.topic: smallholder farmer climate adaptation sub Saharan Africa
topics.research_question: What adaptation practices and constraints are reported for smallholder farmers in sub-Saharan Africa?
topics.language_policy: English, French, and Portuguese metadata retained when available.
topics.document_type_policy: Empirical agriculture, development, and climate studies.
topics.rationale: Tests regional and multilingual coverage without using personally sensitive data.

topics.title: Chinese-language digital humanities
topics.topic: 中国 数字人文 文本分析
topics.research_question: 哪些研究使用文本分析方法开展中国语境下的数字人文研究？
topics.language_policy: Chinese and bilingual metadata prioritized; English-only coverage is a measured limitation.
topics.document_type_policy: Journal and conference research; book reviews excluded by human judgment.
topics.rationale: Tests Unicode queries and non-English metadata coverage.
expected_ambiguity_cases: digital humanities commentary versus applied text analysis

topics.title: Foundation model terminology ambiguity
topics.research_question: Which research evaluates general-purpose machine-learning foundation models?
topics.language_policy: English metadata preferred; missing language advisory.
topics.document_type_policy: Technical evaluations, benchmarks, and surveys; unrelated foundation engineering excluded.
topics.rationale: Tests a phrase shared with engineering, medicine, and organizational foundations.
expected_ambiguity_cases: building foundation models versus structural foundations
